standard_prerequisites.use: H^i(Leta_I M) =~ I^ otimes i  otimes  (H^i(M)/H^i(M)[I]).

core_obligations: The generator f  in  O_{X,x} of I_x is a nonzerodivisor, hence H^i(M)_x[f] = 0 (proof lines 14504-14507).
By the eta-first-property lemma, H^i(Leta_I M)_x =~ I_x^i  otimes _{O_{X,x}} H^i(M)_x, which is free of the same rank as H^i(M)_x (proof lines 14508-14513).
proof_roadmap: Apply the first-property lemma and read off the rank.
difficulty_reason: A local generator f of I_x is a nonzerodivisor, so H^i(M)_x[f] = 0, and the first-property lemma identifies H^i(Leta_I M)_x with I_x^i  otimes  H^i(M)_x, which is free of the same rank.
